description: Foundation: separate-DB connection, Mongoose model, deterministic placement library, profanity filter, and shared type contract. This is the pure/server core everything else depends on; independent of FEAT-002/003 except that they import from it. Build EXACTLY per design.md with MEDIUM fixes 2/3/4/5 and NIT #6 baked in.
steps: Create lib/promiseWallDb.ts: getPromiseWallConnection() using mongoose.createConnection(process.env.PROMISE_WALL_DB_URL).asPromise(), cached on a distinct global.__promiseWallConn key (NOT global.mongoose). Read env at module top but THROW only at call time ('PROMISE_WALL_DB_URL is not defined') so `next build` stays safe. Do not touch lib/db.ts or MONGODB_URI. Mirror the shape in design.md's 'lib/promiseWallDb.ts' code block.

Create model/promiseNoteModel.ts: export interface IPromiseNote and async getPromiseNoteModel() → (conn.models.PromiseNote as Model) || conn.model('PromiseNote', PromiseNoteSchema) on the separate connection. Schema fields exactly per design.md: user_id (String, required, index, PRIVATE), display_name (maxlength 24), is_anonymous, text (maxlength 280), font, color, ink_color, drawing_url, photo_url, drawing_public_id (PRIVATE), photo_public_id (PRIVATE), photo_caption (maxlength 280), pos_x, pos_y, pos_x_v, pos_y_v, rotation (min:-6, max:6), z_index, pin_style (default 'none'), status (enum ['visible','hidden','reported'] default 'visible', index), report_count (default 0); { timestamps: { createdAt: 'created_at', updatedAt: 'updated_at' } }. Indexes: {created_at:-1}, {status:1}, {pos_x:1,pos_y:1}. NIT #6: add a one-line comment that the model must ONLY be created via getPromiseNoteModel() on the separate connection, never mongoose.model(...) on the default connection.

Create lib/notePlacement.ts (pure, dependency-free, deterministic). Export constants: NOTE_W=160, NOTE_H=160, PHOTO_NOTE_H=210, V_WALL_WIDTH=420, H_WALL_HEIGHT=900, H_WALL_SEED_WIDTH=2400, V_WALL_SEED_HEIGHT=2000, GROWTH_STEP=1200, Z_CAP=9000. Export noteBox(isPhoto) → { w: NOTE_W, h: isPhoto ? PHOTO_NOTE_H : NOTE_H }. Export rotatedAABB(w,h,deg) → inflate to AABB of rotated rect about center (w'=w·cosθ+h·sinθ, h'=w·sinθ+h·cosθ). Export coveredFraction(A, higherZBoxes): 10x10 raster of A (cellW=A.w/10, cellH=A.h/10, cell(i,j) center=(A.pos_x+(i+0.5)cellW, A.pos_y+(j+0.5)cellH)), count cells whose center lies inside any higher-z box, return covered/100. Export placeNote(input) with mulberry32 seeded PRNG: jittered grid of slots (~noteW*1.1 × noteH*1.1), pick lowest-local-density slot, add ±30px jitter + ±6° rotation, reject if EITHER (a) overlapArea(incoming,A)/(A.w*A.h) > 0.35 for any A OR (b) coveredFraction(A, higher-z boxes incl. incoming) > 0.40 for any A; extend wall by GROWTH_STEP and retry until placed.

Bake MEDIUM fix 2 into notePlacement + model usage: isPhoto = Boolean(photo_url) is the ONLY height-determining flag; every existing note's box uses rotatedAABB(NOTE_W, isPhoto ? PHOTO_NOTE_H : NOTE_H, rotation).

Bake MEDIUM fix 3: horizontal pass seeds wall.width = H_WALL_SEED_WIDTH and grows width by GROWTH_STEP; vertical pass fixes wall.width = V_WALL_WIDTH, seeds wall.height = V_WALL_SEED_HEIGHT and grows height by GROWTH_STEP; growth is monotonic (never shrinks) so re-placement is deterministic.
Bake MEDIUM fix 4: horizontal pass uses fixed wall.height = H_WALL_HEIGHT (device-independent), NOT any viewport value.

Bake MEDIUM fix 5: coveredFraction callers pass the rotation-inflated RECENTRED box { pos_x: cx - w'/2, pos_y: cy - h'/2, w: w', h: h' } for A AND every higher-z box; boundary rule reject iff STRICTLY MORE THAN 40 of 100 cells covered (exactly 40 PASSES). 'Stacks above' uses the strict total-order comparator (z_index, created_at, _id) compared lexicographically. seed derived from the note's _id hex (32-bit hash).

Create lib/profanity.ts: isClean(input) per design contract — null/empty/whitespace → true; normalize (lowercase → NFKD + strip /[\u0300-\u036f]/g → leetspeak map @→a 0→o 1→i 3→e $→s 5→s 7→t 4→a → collapse runs >2 to 2); tokenize on /[^a-z]+/; dirty iff any token EXACTLY equals a BLOCKED entry (whole-word, not substring). BLOCKED is a small curated in-repo constant array (conservative).

Create app/(site)/musafir-cafe/types.ts: NoteFont, NoteColor, NoteInk, PinStyle, PublicNote (per design, with `mine`, no user_id), and INK_FOR_COLOR allow-map (kraft excludes brown; blue paper excludes blue ink). This is the single source of truth imported by both the POST handler and the composer.
acceptance_criteria: lib/promiseWallDb.ts, model/promiseNoteModel.ts, lib/notePlacement.ts, lib/profanity.ts, and app/(site)/musafir-cafe/types.ts all exist and compile under TypeScript (no new tsc errors).

placeNote never violates the 35% per-note cap or the 60% cumulative-visibility rule on rotation-inflated boxes; the three-disjoint-20%-overlaps arrangement is REJECTED; a placement with exactly 40 covered cells PASSES; identical (existing, wall, orientation, seed) inputs yield identical output.
rotatedAABB(w,h,0) is identity; rotatedAABB at 6° grows a 160px box ~10%.
isClean returns true for clean/empty/Scunthorpe-type inputs and false for blocked whole words and their leetspeak/diacritic variants.
The model is created only via getPromiseNoteModel() on the separate connection (comment present); lib/db.ts and MONGODB_URI are untouched.
verification: Write a throwaway `node` script (e.g. tmp-feat001-check.mjs, deleted after) importing/replicating placeNote, coveredFraction, rotatedAABB, and isClean to assert: 35% cap, three-disjoint-20% rejection, exactly-40-cells boundary pass, rotatedAABB 0°/6°, determinism, and the profanity cases. Record results in .agents/tasks/musafir-cafe/verification.md, then DELETE the script.
Run `npm run build` and `npm run lint`; both must pass with these files present (routes/components come in later FEATs, but these foundation files must not introduce build/lint errors).
